digest.component_or_area: test suite - store read/write contention tests
propositions: test_cli_show_complete_or_erroring_under_write_burst has high runtime variance (10.95-22.63s) and is the slowest node in the default test suite
Two separate test oracles (slim-fetch-ledge regression and generic table-driven property) exist for read-under-write-storm behavior but equivalence is unproven
Fault-seeded testing must establish that both test oracles detect identical failure modes before consolidation is safe
Process concurrency, output completeness, exit codes, timeout enforcement, and cleanup behavior must all remain observable and testable after any consolidation
Wall-clock timing measurements on macOS and Ubuntu are required to calculate aggregate test runner savings from consolidation
